request.query: calendly.com company profile: industry, number of employees, countries it sells to, website languages, how its team works (remote, hybrid, or office), and whether it is hiring
request.systemPrompt: Research the company that owns the website calendly.com. Prefer the company's own site (about, careers, help, store) and reputable business sources. Report facts only. If a fact cannot be determined, use "unknown" for strings, 0 for numbers, false for booleans, and an empty list for arrays. Never guess.
additionalQueries: calendly.com careers: open roles, remote or hybrid or in-office work, office locations
calendly.com about us: company size, headquarters, and countries or markets served
calendly.com online store e-commerce platform and tech stack

highlights.query: company size, markets served, remote or office work, open roles, online store platform

employee_count.description: Approximate total number of employees; 0 if unknown

sells_to.description: Who the company primarily sells to

online_store_platform.description: E-commerce platform behind its online store (e.g. 'Shopify'); 'none' if it does not sell online; 'unknown' if it cannot be determined

countries_served.description: Countries or regions it sells or ships to, one per item. If it serves many, list its largest markets, or a count such as '150+ countries'

website_languages.description: Languages its website, store, or help pages are offered in

work_model.description: How most employees work, from its careers pages and job posts: remote-first, hybrid, or in an office

actively_hiring.description: Whether its careers page or job boards list open roles right now

handles_sensitive_data.description: Whether the company's core product involves customers' health or financial records (health tracking, banking, insurance, lending). Taking card payments at checkout does not count

properties.name: Calendly
properties.description:
Calendly connects the entire meeting workflow — scheduling, payments, meeting notes, follow-ups, contacts, and more — and handles the work before, during, and after meetings. From solo business owners to teams within large organizations, more than 50 million people across 240+ countries trust Calendly to help them get more out of every meeting.

If you're thinking about joining us, we want the people who build Calendly to experience the same value our customers do. You'll own tangible work, see it reach real customers, and grow through the challenges that come with building something meaningful. We're remote-first, guided by strong values, working alongside people who care about the work and each other.
